instructions.goal: Build database models incrementally so development is manageable for a solo developer.
instructions.usage: Follow phases in order. Only move to the next phase once the previous phase is stable.
instructions.note: All listed models are eventual requirements, but only implement them when you reach their phase.

phases.title: Core MVP Models
phases.purpose: Enable basic project → API → testcase creation and manual execution.
phases.when_to_implement: Immediately. These models form the minimum base required to run the application.

phases.title: Essential Testing Support
phases.purpose: Enable execution history, debugging, and multi-environment testing.
phases.when_to_implement: After basic test creation and execution features are done.

phases.title: Advanced Validation Logic
phases.purpose: Provide fine-grained validation and allow rule-based test generation.
phases.when_to_implement: After test history and environments are stable. Useful for more accurate validation and schema-based auto-generation.

phases.title: Organization & Test Grouping
phases.purpose: Help users organize large test collections.
phases.when_to_implement: Only when users need grouping features like smoke tests, regression suites, or integration collections.

phases.title: Advanced / Optional Enhancements
phases.purpose: Professional-level features helpful when the system grows.
phases.when_to_implement: Only after everything else works and if product goals require multi-step workflows or scheduled monitoring.
